behaviors: Matches host SHELL, /etc/shells and platform fallback admission. Host entries are trimmed and blank/comments discarded, while caller argv is matched exactly. Empty or whitespace-only request preserves the raw nonempty host default; absent/empty SHELL falls back to the platform first choice. Windows additionally compares lowercased basenames.

Fixed Rust inserting raw SHELL directly into allowed set: wrapped host paths now match their trimmed allowlist identity and comment values cannot qualify an explicitly requested executable. Private input seam exercises environment/file/fallback positive floors, arbitrary executable/argument/relative/bare-command/comment refusals and exact default spelling without mutating global environment.

Actual registered terminals.create refusal now checks the login-shell error, preventing missing executable/backend failures from passing. The same real embedded PTY integration launches the valid fallback and exercises replay/input/resize/leases/shutdown, preserving a handler admission floor.
intentionalChanges: No new shell policy or authority layer: retained host login-shell selection is separate from ambient filesystem paths. The legacy POSIX /etc/shells fixture maps to deterministic private-input tests; Windows runtime and Windows basename assertions remain a host-gated validation requirement.
